title: Step-by-Step Guide: Apply For Your Ayushman Bharat Health Card Online
text:
Step-by-Step Guide: Apply For Your Ayushman Bharat Health Card Online
The Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) provides cashless and paperless hospitalisation coverage of up to Rs 5 lakh per family annually.
Healthcare costs in India are steadily rising and posing a significant financial burden, especially for those dependent on private hospitals or managing chronic illnesses. To help ease this strain, the Government of India launched the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY).
This scheme offers cashless and paperless hospitalisation coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, making quality healthcare more accessible. PM-JAY marks a major step toward achieving Universal Health Coverage (UHC) by ensuring that every citizen can receive essential medical services without facing financial hardship.

What is an Ayushman Card?
The Ayushman Bharat Card is issued under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) and is linked to the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), enabling easy access to quality healthcare services and benefits covered under the scheme.
How to apply for the Ayushman Card?
Here we have mentioned the step-by-step guide to apply for the Ayushman Bharat Card online. Take a look:
Step 1: Navigate to the official PMJAY Website.
Step 2: Upon reaching the homepage, click on ‘Am I Eligible’ option on the top menu.
Step 3: Enter your Mobile Number, OTP and Captcha Code for verification.
Step 4: Click on the Login button and wait for the page to reload.
Step 5: Select the appropriate option from the State, District, and Search By columns and enter the necessary information.
Step 6: Next up, click on the Do e-KYC option.
Step 7: To authenticate, choose the Aadhaar OTP option. Your Aadhaar number will become accessible. Click Verify.
Step 8: After entering the Aadhaar OTP and Mobile OTP, you will get an e-KYC Completion message on your device.
Step 9: 15-20 minutes after e-KYC, log in to the PMJAY website and select the Download Card button.
Step 10: You will be registered for the Ayushman Bharat Yojana.
Documents Required:
Aadhaar Card
Valid ID proof as a Driving License, Voter ID Card or Passport.
Residential proof documents like utility bills, a passport or a voter ID
Family information, including the name and Aadhaar number of each member.
Income Certificate
Bank Account Details
Caste certificates from beneficiaries belonging to specific categories
The medical scheme was launched on September 23, 2018, in Ranchi, Jharkhand, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
